value.text: Diagnosis (R2 read-only live + private seed). Live: pij-rs --json state took 1.65 s (pij-state-cards) and 15.27 s (pij-different-smelt, 3.59M rows). EXPLAIN on the live store: Spine::tail(Some(seat), 0) = SEARCH rowid>? (whole spine). Private seed via evidence/private-cards.sh (4,158,818 rows, 1,893 seats) on main 2d9ea28 release: 1.31 s / 1.30 s / 1.74 s / 15.2 s; 4 concurrent 6.6-7.0 s. Cause: three seat tails per card (card, note, holds), each a full scan; the OR defeats spine_by_seat. Concurrency: no lock (4-conn pool); 4 sqlite3 processes on the same scan slow 0.43 -> 1.40 s each (memory bandwidth/page cache). Pointer sent to pij-far-jackal before fixing. evidence/diagnosis.md, plans-main.txt, sample-main-4.txt.

Red on main 2d9ea28 (git archive + only the new test files): card_tests 3/3 FAILED (a_card_read_never_tails_the_spine and the_state_note_cites_its_own_record: 500 'counting-spine: ... performed unbounded Spine::tail'; the_bulk_read_is_the_single_read_for_every_seat: 404); report_http 2/2 FAILED (the_state_note_carries_its_own_time_and_cursor: stateNoteAt left Null, right 1793577995412; the_bulk_card_read_matches_the_single_read_on_the_real_store: 404). Store plan tests pin new constants (not compilable on main); their red is the seat-tail-or-defeats-index and holds-without-indexed-by mutants (lg-0006). evidence/red-main.txt.

Commit 07fcd6d. Green: cargo test --no-fail-fast -p pij-store -p pij-core -p pij-testkit -p pij-daemon -p pij-sidecars: all targets ok except load timeouts under load average ~20-27 (12 http::native_tests 'process observation ... timed out after 1000ms', 1 fyi_http 'pool timed out', 1 pane_observer real-tmux sink race), each re-run green alone (native_tests 42/42, fyi_http 19/19, pane_observer 3/3); corpus test caught the unindexed golden, fixed in MANIFEST.toml (6/6). cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings exit 0; cargo fmt --all --check ok.

Golden comparison over every seat on the seed: /v1/state for all 1,893 seats on main (46 min) and branch (40 s); compare.py: compared=1893 identical=1893 differ=0 after removing only stateNoteAt/stateNoteSeq (318 with a card, 16 with a note, 1 with a hold); stateNoteAt/Seq present exactly when stateNote is, on every seat. Seeds identical (head 4,158,818 on both; main boot wrote no rows). evidence/golden-compare.txt (with the two JSONL sha256s; the JSONL carries live card text and is not committed).

Private timings, release builds, each daemon alone: main single 1.54-1.99 s, 3.59M-row seat 12.3-13.6 s, 4 concurrent 4.4-5.3 s each; branch single 1.7-5.2 ms, 3.59M-row seat 4.4-5.0 ms, 4 concurrent 2.6-7.2 ms each, 4 different seats 1.9-5.8 ms; GET /v1/cards 86 cards in 49-64 ms (6 readings); branch RSS 68 MB after 1,893 cards. No cache (no memory per seat), no new loop/poll/launch site. evidence/timings-main.txt, timings-branch.txt; docs/how/daemon-cost.md 'Measured (plan 188)'. Deployed reading: the prime's, after merge.

Mutants (evidence/mutants.py, mutants.txt): baseline green; 8/8 killed, restored green. scan-card-and-note-via-tail -> card_tests 4 FAILED (500 tail); scan-holds-via-tail -> card_tests 4 FAILED; seat-tail-or-defeats-index -> a_seat_tail_seeks FAILED (rowid>? vs spine_by_seat); holds-without-indexed-by -> all_matching_seeks FAILED (spine_by_seat (seat=?) vs spine_by_seat_kind); bulk-drops-held -> bulk==single FAILED; bulk-includes-tombstoned -> ids FAILED; note-time-from-card -> note test FAILED (150 vs 130) and report_http FAILED; note-time-kept-after-clear -> report_http FAILED. 'Stale cache after a new report': not applicable, no cache was added; the_state_note_carries_its_own_time_and_cursor reads after each new report.
CI on PR #105 at 07fcd6d (run 41366399977): rust-lint, rust-test, check (22), check (24) all pass. CI on the final head is reported in the PR and the reply to the prime.

Review of #105 (review-105-pij-review-pr105.md) fixes. S1: the bulk read bounds each seat's session read at LIST_STATUS_WAIT (200 ms) and names an overrun 'no answer within 200 ms' in that card's sessionStatus; /v1/state unchanged. S2: per-seat failures go to unavailable: [{id, error}] instead of a 500. S3/N1: spine_contract pins latest-by-seq with an earlier `at`, and seat-tail exclusivity. N2: a 5-seat fleet, first seat slowest, one with a role. N3: every note path already refuses an empty note (report.rs:348), now pinned by an_empty_note_is_refused_so_no_note_time_cites_one. N4: filed as issue #106. Red on the PR head 96421ee (evidence/red-review.txt): S2 500, S1 'waited on a session read that never returns: Elapsed', N2 unavailable Null. Mutants (evidence/mutants-review.txt) 6/6 killed: latest-by-at-not-seq (Seq(1) vs Seq(7)), seat-tail-inclusive-since, bulk-skips-roles (Null vs prime), bulk-completion-order (a last), bulk-unbounded-session (timeout), bulk-one-error-fails-all (500).
